evidence.quote: Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation revised CPI Base Year to 2024, Replacing 2012 Benchmark.
Goldar Named Chairman, to decide Base Year for GDP Data in 2024.
Identifies 2024 as CPI Base Year Using 2023-24 Household Consumer Expenditure Survey Data.
Formula Used: Laspeyres Index Formula (Based on Base Year Prices, Base Year Weights, Current Prices)
Divisions, Groups, Classes and Subclasses in line with COICOP 2018.
Overall Inflation Jan 2026 (YoY): 2.75% (Provisional) — Rural Inflation: 2.73% | Urban Inflation: 2.77%
Newly Added Items: OTT Subscriptions, Rural House Rent, Value — added
